info.title: docfx-ri — DocFX build with remote-include support.
info.description: Inline remote markdown content into DocFX builds via an authenticated HTTP source.

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to remoteinclude.json (default: sibling of docfx.json).

options.name: --allow-missing
options.description:
Render error placeholders instead of failing on fetch errors.
Config precedence (highest first):
1. CLI flags
2. remoteinclude.json
3. Environment variables (DOCFX_RI_BASE_URL, DOCFX_RI_TOKEN)
4. Built-in defaults
Directive syntax in markdown:
[!remoteinclude[title](source "hint")]
